title: Address Greptile P2 re-review finding on PR #1301 (loadHealthPoints row scope)
rationale: On Greptile's re-review after the first round of fixes, one new P2 remained: loadHealthPoints ran `SELECT data FROM resources`, scanning every row (profile, settings, identity, irn_profile) and relying on ExtractPoints to discard non-point rows. On a large store this loads non-health rows into memory unnecessarily.

changes.summary: Scoped the query to the known data-point resource types via `WHERE resource_type IN (...)` built from googleHealthDataTypes() (the same set sync writes). The resources table has an index on resource_type, so the filter is cheap. Behavior-preserving: sync only ever writes data points under these types, and ExtractPoints would have discarded the excluded rows anyway.
changes.validated_outcome: go build/vet pass; cli + health tests pass (go test -count=1 ./internal/cli/ ok); analytics commands operate on the same point set as before.
